verdict.rationale: Mercury documents automatic categorization of transactions in Books. It also says transactions are 'automatically assigned GL codes based on your categorization history and AI-driven suggestions', which implies learning from prior categorizations, and Command lets users create categorization rules. However, the learning claim comes from a post about Mercury transactions syncing to external ledgers, not explicitly from Books. Nothing documents that corrections specifically retrain suggestions, or that imported external-account transactions get the same learned suggestions. Mercury's own framing is that software still leaves decisions to the user. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that user corrections feed back into future suggestions within Books, explicit coverage of imported/linked external-account transactions, independent or hands-on corroboration of suggestion accuracy and learning.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get automatic categorization suggestions for imported transactions that learn from my corrections
